Context: 1. Allotment of Quarters

No allotment of quarters to an officer whose spouse has been Government quarters will not be allotted to an officer  
allotted quarters.- whose spouse has been allotted a quarter, except under specific circumstances. When two allottees in occupation of separate accommodation marry each other, they shall within one month of marriage, surrender one of the accommodation. - Rule 24 (1) and (2).
